project_comments.note: The constraints.md HubL Translation Coverage line (line 64) lists only 6 commands, but the Translator/Syntax/HubL/ directory contains 17 translation files: ShowVariable, ShowEncoded, ShowURL, SetVariable, ShowDate, For, If, ElseIf, Else, End, Break, ShowSnippet (stub), ShowNumber, ShowPhone, Comment, Code, Mono. This is a significant manifest inaccuracy that would cause any agent doing manifest-first lookups to incorrectly conclude HubL does not support showphone, shownumber, mono, code, comment, else, end, or break. A dedicated manifest audit WP should reconstruct this coverage table with two columns: (1) fully translated and (2) not-supported stubs (Break, ShowSnippet). Recommend scheduling this before the next manifest-driven agent cycle.

Cross-cutting observation: The single most impactful follow-up is the HubL Manifest Audit WP. The constraints.md HubL coverage table lists only 6 commands against 17 actual translation files — a gap that will mislead every future manifest-first agent. This must be resolved before the next agent cycle. Second priority: add HubLShowSnippetTests.php as a regression guard for the permanent stub behavior flagged by 3+ consecutive pipelines. Third: evaluate a BaseSyntax::isCommandSupported() hook to eliminate the structural need for stub-only translation files.
